data.version: Source fit 32768 IDs, fresh cache epoch21/22/23
data.representation: source received/clean IQ and simulator kernel, widely-linear coefficients, variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: Same 32768 training fit IDs, excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and 672 source pilot

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Matched source physical IDs and cached simulator action; no target or F

permissions.claim_scope: Source training distribution of artificial response-to-residual ratio only; not SNR or TX accuracy

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA only for first two source no-query smoke; simulator IQ and action for source statistics
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original source DURA provenance; same legal 32768 source fit and matching simulated action metadata
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA; no target score selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, preserve all GPU and other owner tasks
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract mismatch, nonfinite values, zero residual/effect, output collision or failed real-checkpoint source smoke; preserve other tasks.

expected_artifacts: result.json: source train per scene and selected artificial direction quantiles, 1% and 10% equivalent relative energy
source_visibility.npz: source scene, selected direction and relative dB for each practical training view

metric_names: source synthetic perturbation effect energy divided by observed-minus-simulated-clean residual energy in dB
dimensions: 32768 source records x 3 cached views; six practical scenes analyzed
one of four fixed directions per view
clean scene counted but omitted because residual can be zero

rows.method: Compare actual fixed 1% perturbations on source train action to observed-minus-simulated-clean residual; infer 10% by exact real-linear scaling
rows.purpose: Quantify actual source training signal relative to residual without TX labels or F
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.scenario: epochs21/22/23 source training; six practical views analyzed, clean counted separately
rows.budget_ref: 32768 IDs x 3 views; CPU only; first two legal source samples real DURA no-query smoke
expected_artifacts: result.json: source train per scene and selected artificial direction quantiles, 1% and 10% equivalent relative energy
source_visibility.npz: source scene, selected direction and relative dB for each practical training view

notes: Residual includes noise and simulator/representation mismatch, not pure noise or SNR; synthetic perturbations are not verified identity information.
10% response energy ratio is inferred as 1% ratio plus 20 dB for fixed real-linear action and fixed observed residual, not an independent end-to-end simulator rerun.
Source training IQ only, no F/TX/V/target or model updates; no modification or selection of existing candidates.
Clean-scenario residual can be exactly zero, so clean views are counted and excluded from ratios; zero residual in a practical view is an explicit failure.
